newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo affiliates seek receivership.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo affiliates seek receivership.

text.p: Three affiliates of Hanbo Steel Co will seek court receivership either on Monday or Tuesday, Hanbo's major creditor said on Monday.

"The Hanbo Group has decided to seek court receivership for four of its member companies, including Hanbo Steel," a spokesman of Korea First Bank said. Hanbo Steel, the flagship of Hanbo Group, said last week it would file for receivership on Monday.
The three affiliates are Sang-A Pharmaceutical Co Ltd and two unlisted firms Hanbo Corp and Hanbo Energy Co Ltd, he said.

The spokesman said Hanbo Group, South Korea's 14th largest industrial conglomerate, wanted to file for receivership for the four member firms on Monday but the move could be delayed until Tuesday due to paperwork.
Hanbo Steel, Hanbo Corp and Hanbo Energy have defaulted on debt repayments, he said.

Officials of the Ministry of Fianance and Economy said Hanbo Group's loans from financial institutions totalled about five trillion won, against its net worth of 224.3 billion won. They said Hanbo ran into financial trouble after investing heavily in a steel mill with capacity of six million tonnes a year.
